source_text:
Brand owner: Moya Community Clinic
Product name: Mobile Care Pilot
Short name: Mobile Care
Offer: community mobile clinic appointments
Promise: Provide scheduled primary-care appointments at five community sites.
Proof: The September service log records 240 completed appointments.
Call to action: Request the next-quarter schedule.
Audience: Moya Clinic operations committee
Audience pain: Monthly site reports are split across five clinic spreadsheets.
Audience outcome: One monthly view of scheduled and completed appointments.
